title: The knight
info: A knight moves in an L: two squares one way, then one square to the side.
It can jump, so pieces in between do not block it.

questions.q: The knight's move is shaped like
Pieces between a knight and its landing square
A knight alternates color each move because
options: the L lands on the other color

questions.q: Which is a knight move from a square?
options: two up and one to the side
